name: Look to the Stars
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Renamed from Look To The Stars. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details: According to Cog's blueprint, what I need now is a way to reflect light.  I remember a woman by the name of Mary who became well known around these parts for always carrying a looking glass.  Perhaps you can track Mary down and see if she might lend us a reflective surface for this project?  I believe she once resided in southern Duskwood. . .
narrative.objectives: Locate Mary and persuade her to give up a reflective surface for Viktori's project.
narrative.offerRewardText: Why yes, I used to own a looking glass.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 25 to 30, 6,950 XP in all.
